items.headline: S&P Says It May Downgrade Nvidia’s Ratings on Governance Worries
items.excerpt: S&P Global Ratings is looking at cutting Nvidia Corp.’s credit by one notch, citing concerns over the company’s management and governance following the departure, and then the return, of Chief Executive Officer Jensen Huang.

items.headline: Netflix to Buy Radford Studio Center for $380 Million
items.excerpt: Bloomberg's John Gittelsohn discusses Netflix’s purchase of the historic Radford Studio Center in Los Angeles. The $380 million price is about 80% below the $1.85 billion Hackman Capital Partners paid for the property in 2021. (Source: Bloomberg)

items.headline: Billions in Data Center Deals Grind to Halt After AI Chip Curbs
